text:
At midday, a small mix-up at the desk touched supply orders and briefly slowed the normal flow of companion animal check-in support. Routine materials for crates, labels, and comfort items were being reviewed when the team noticed that a few items had been sorted into the wrong storage tray. The issue did not affect any traveler directly, but it made the work surface less orderly and created a short delay while the desk staff confirmed what was needed for the next several companion animal bookings.

The senior coordinator and the assistant on duty paused the intake line, checked the remaining stock, and separated the misplaced items by hand. Clear labels were reviewed again, and the workstation was tidied before any new passenger guidance was given. During this correction, the staff kept the tone calm and reassuring, so travelers at the counter continued to receive patient attention. One pet was also brought through the usual comfort steps without interruption, and the handling remained gentle throughout.

Once the supplies were put back in the correct places, the team completed a quick inventory review and compared it with the standard list used for routine desk work. The review showed that the supply mix-up was limited to storage placement and did not involve damaged items or unsafe handling. A brief note was entered for follow-up, and the staff agreed to slow the pace of restocking when the counter is busy, so the same confusion is less likely to happen again.

This event was minor, contained, and resolved with steady teamwork.
